hero.label: How it works
hero.title: A simpler, safer way to hire & get hired
hero.description: Klick-Pro connects clients with verified professionals through a secure, milestone-based escrow workflow. Here is how the end-to-end process works.

items.title: 1. Post your job
items.description: Describe what you need, choose a service category, and specify your budget and timeline. It takes under two minutes.

items.title: 2. Receive & compare quotes
items.description: Verified professionals review your job and send customized proposals. Chat directly, compare ratings, and choose the best match.

items.title: 3. Fund secure escrow
items.description: Accept a proposal and deposit milestone funds into secure escrow. Money is protected safely by Klick-Pro before work begins.

items.title: 4. Collaborate & track milestones
items.description: Professionals start work, update stages, share progress, and submit completed deliverables directly within the project tracker.

items.title: 5. Inspect & release payment
items.description: Review the submitted deliverables. Once you approve the work, funds are released directly to the professional's wallet.

items.title: 6. Rate & review
items.description: Both parties leave verified reviews and ratings upon project completion, helping build reputation and trust across the community.

hero.label: For clients
hero.title: Hire trusted pros — without the back-and-forth
hero.description: Post once. Get qualified, vetted proposals fast. Pay securely only when work is completed and approved.

items.title: 1. Post your job requirement
items.description: Describe your task or project, choose the service category, and set your budget and timeline. It's completely free to post.

items.title: 2. Get verified proposals
items.description: Receive competitive quotes from ID-verified, background-checked professionals. Review their ratings, completed projects, and client feedback.

items.title: 3. Chat & finalize scope
items.description: Message professionals in real-time to discuss details, ask questions, negotiate terms, and shortlist the top candidate.

items.title: 4. Secure escrow deposit
items.description: Deposit milestone payments securely through Razorpay. Your money is held safely in escrow and never released upfront.

items.title: 5. Track work & inspect results
items.description: Follow project stages in real-time, inspect deliverables uploaded by your pro, and request revisions until you are 100% satisfied.

items.title: 6. Release payment & review
items.description: Approve the completed milestone to release payment to the pro, then leave a review to help others in the community.

items.title: What is Klick-Pro?
items.description: Klick-Pro is a marketplace that connects clients with verified professionals for local and remote work.

items.title: Is it free to use?
items.description: Posting jobs and creating a profile are free. Clients pay only the agreed price.

items.title: How are professionals vetted?
items.description: Every pro completes ID verification. For in-home services, we also run background checks.
